limits: Scope acceleration covers V2 picker credential preparation, not all service or wallet queries or cloud sync.
Single sequential measurements have cache/order effects; no cold/warm benchmark or speed percentage claim.
Native MDBX support covers known login/card/document/address payloads; unknown/unreadable/archived/conflicting objects never fall back to mirrors.
New MDBX URL binding remains unavailable; separate :ime native MDBX integration is not implemented.
Final native reread and Android fill are not a cross-process atomic transaction.
R8 isolated packages use the same debug signing certificate for Release upgrade, not store signing.
Entry probes launch real Activities directly; authentication/cancel is not complete framework or full keyboard filling. Debug MDBX framework tests are separate evidence.
Synthetic API35/x86_64 only: no user data, real cloud, hardware key, physical OEM or other API/ABI validation.
First failures and same-package reruns do not prove a production timing fix or deterministic stability.
No screenshots, raw UI snapshots, passwords or machine-private paths are included.
